attchmntText: Madhav Marbles and Granites Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Madhav Marbles and Granites Limited reported a standalone net loss of 161.62 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net profit of 3.11 lakhs in the same period last year. Consolidated net loss stood at 201.15 lakhs. The Board approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee effective November 14, 2026, with Mr. Devendra Manchanda as Chairman. The company processed an ODI filing for an equity application of OMR 300,000 in Madhav Surfaces FZC LLC. The trading window for dealing in company securities remains closed until 48 hours after the financial results are made public. Statutory auditors issued a modified opinion on the limited review reports.
